Yaspa Wins Payment Solution of the Year Award at SBC Awards 2026
summary:
Yaspa, a leading fintech specialising in intelligent payments solutions, has won the Payment Solution of the Year category at the SBC Awards 2026, hosted on 1st October. 
Yaspa overcame stiff competition to claim the award that concluded the SBC Summit Lisbon 2026. 
The SBC Awards recognise and reward the very best operators, affiliates, suppliers, payments and game developers across the European sports betting & gaming industry.
James Neville, CEO of Yaspa, said: “We’re thrilled to be named as Payment Solution of the Year by the SBC award judges and congratulate all the other winners and shortlisted companies.”
“This recognition from the iGaming industry after a successful Summit in Lisbon is a huge honour for everyone involved with Yaspa.”
In 2026 so far, Yaspa has been named Best Payment Solution Provider at the European iGaming Awards and Payment Solution of the Year at the SBC Awards Europe. In June, Yaspa won two awards at the EGR B2B Awards; AI Solutions Provider and Safer Gambling Supplier. It was also named as one of CB Insights Top 100 Fintechs, a global ranking that spotlights the most promising and innovative companies shaping the future of financial services. 
This comes during a period of sustained growth for Yaspa in the past 18 months and closed a $12m investment round last year, led by Discerning Capital. This growth has culminated in the opening of its new Atlanta office in the US, as well as the opening of its tech hub in Leeds, UK, in August 2025.

Plume Accelerates Tokenization’s Role in Global Finance with nBND Vault
summary:
Plume, the Open Finance platform for institutional assets, today announces the launch of its new nBND vault. For the first time, allocators can access a tokenized vault backed by Fidelity Total Bond ETF (FBND) as its primary reserve asset.
The maturity of onchain capital markets requires access to diverse assets that are battle tested and managed by world class financial institutions. Through the vault, Plume is supporting the development of a robust fixed-income market, not simply providing another isolated yield opportunity.
"While the onchain fixed income market was originally concentrated in short-duration Treasuries and money market equivalents, these are the starting points, not the destination. Institutional allocators want duration, and active management, the same building blocks they use offchain," said Chris Yin, CEO and Co-Founder of Plume.
This year, the tokenized U.S. treasuries market grew from $12 billion in April 2026 to $15 billion in June, just two months later. This is only a fraction of the global fixed income market that represents over $100 trillion in assets. Should this entire market be tokenized, as expected and outlined by respected asset management executives, the growth opportunity is considerable.
Collaboration between crypto-native and traditional financial institutions is essential in nurturing this market, bridging the technical infrastructure of blockchain with the expertise, and institutional trust that traditional finance has built over decades.
Institutional appetite for proven, yield-bearing assets onchain is apparent and this vault ensures this next phase of development continues.
"As tokenized assets and on-chain applications become more integrated into mainstream market infrastructure, a collaborative ecosystem is essential to expanding investment access," said Cynthia Lo Bessette, Head of Digital Asset Management at Fidelity Investments. "We're excited to collaborate with Plume to bring financial products on-chain, providing a broader set of investors with access to greater programmability to build custom portfolios, alongside investment solutions that unlock new forms of collateral utility and access to capital."

title: Libertex Group Joins iFX EXPO Asia 2026 as Platinum Sponsor
summary:
Libertex Group has announced its attendance at iFX EXPO Asia 2026 as a Platinum Sponsor. The event sponsorship grants the nearly 30-year-old global fintech powerhouse a prominent position on the expo floor at Booth #60.
From 7-9th of October, the Libertex Group will be showcasing two of its core brands, LBX and Forex Club. The team will  be striking up conversations with industry professionals and traders to discuss the brands’ offerings, partnerships and their  award-winning Introducing Broker (IB) and Affiliate Programmes.
Trusted since 1997, the Libertex Group has steadily grown into a multibrand retail trading powerhouse known for its integrity and competitive offerings, serving millions of traders throughout Europe, Latin America and Southeast Asia. 
Regulated across several jurisdictions in these regions, LBX and Forex Club each come with an offering designed to fill the demands of different market segments of the retail trading industry.
Geo-focused brokerage brands, a unified group vision
Libertex Group is one of the industry’s most trusted and highly respected names. Through its platforms, traders can access thousands of trading instruments with underlying assets including Forex pairs, cryptocurrencies, commodities, ETFs, stocks and commission-free investment in real stock shares. 
Built with a vision to democratise access to trading and investing, the Libertex proprietary platform is recognised for its stability, smooth navigation and advanced trading tools. Over the years, this strong infrastructure and offering have earned the broker more than 45 industry awards, including last year’s Best Online Trading Platform at the FinTech Breakthrough Awards.
LBX and Forex Club are driven by the same force and vision. At iFX EXPO Asia, they’ll be presenting their partnership programmes and exclusive offerings to Affiliates and IBs across Southeast Asia and beyond.
LBX brings the F1® experience to Hong Kong
As the Official Online Trading Partner of the Audi Revolut F1® team, LBX brings the unique high-speed experience to iFX EXPO Asia. This experience is centred on an interactive F1® Reaction Challenge set up at the booth.
As its name suggests, the game tests reaction speed, perceptiveness and focus; it requires participants to react to a high-speed five-light start sequence by “pushing” the throttle pedal as quickly as they can once the lights go out. Just like in reality, the time interval between the final red light and lights-out varies randomly.
A leaderboard will be displayed, ranking participants by reaction time. Each day’s winner will be announced in the afternoon and will receive an official Audi Revolut F1® Team cap personally signed by one of the drivers.
Apart from the fun experience, LBX also comes with a solid value proposition for Affiliates and IBs across Southeast Asia. The broker offers up to $50 per lot in rebates to all IBs, based on a 24-hour rebate cycle alongside loyalty plans beyond immediate earnings. The live reporting feature complements these advantages, offering each IB Partner a clear overview of their earnings in real time.
Affiliates are also remunerated handsomely, should they opt for LBX’s Affiliate Programme. Competitive CPA, revenue sharing and hybrid plans await Affiliate Partners. Depending on their business model, each partner can unlock fixed-fee rewards for every qualified referral, a percentage of each of their referral’s activity for as long as they trade, or a combination of both.
This flexibility allows partners to choose terms that match their growth stage and scale effectively. 
Forex Club shows that tradition and innovation coexist
Building on the Libertex Group’s 30-year legacy, Forex Club blends tradition with a modern approach to trading to create a fair, transparent and stable trading environment where traders and partners can achieve their goals.
The broker operates on the same Libertex Group infrastructure, which means that competitive spreads, pricing transparency and excellent customer service are the standard. Providing access to a wide range of CFD instruments on Forex, indices, precious metals and energies, Forex Club has passed the test of time, boasting a user base of over 3 million traders worldwide.
IB Partners are equally well rewarded, enjoying flexible choices across Forex Club’s partnership programme. The programme features up to $50 trade rebates, an exclusive loyalty plan, a five-tier referral system and daily rebates and payouts, alongside copy trading and a consolidated dashboard for real-time revenue monitoring.
Advantages like these deliver value to partners, giving them the confidence to grow consistently over time.
Meet us at Booth #60!
Both Forex Club and LBX will be in Hong Kong this October, attending iFX EXPO Asia. Sharing booth #60 with the Libertex Group, they’ll be offering deep dives into their tailored offerings and an engaging experience with the exclusive Audi Revolut F1® Challenge hosted by LBX. 
Don’t let this opportunity pass you by. Contact the team to secure your slot in advance.
